items.applies_to: micrographs, the compositions and the constituent phases
items.quote: The micrographs, the compositions and the constituent phases were observed by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) equipped with energy disperse spectroscopy (EDS) (JSM6480LV).
The composition variations across the connection interface of the annealed diffusion couples were determined by the EPMA method.
Correspondingly, the tested values of the diffusion couples by electron probe microanalysis (EPMA) (GEOL-JXA-8230) are conducive to support the isothermal treatment results.

The phase separation temperatures of the samples with different compositions and the border of the miscibility gap of the Mo-V binary system were measured by SDT/Q-600 apparatus, which can be used for measurements of either differential thermal analysis (DTA) or differential scanning calorimetry (DSC).
The cross-sectional specimens were prepared in an ion thinning instrument (Gatan 691) and were characterized by a TEM apparatus (FEI Tecnai TF30-FEG STwin) operated at 300 kV.

The polished high purity Mo (99.99 wt%) and V (99.99 wt%) bricks were compressed at 12 MPa at 1000   C for 10 min for minutes under the vacuum condition by a thermal simulation testing machine (GLEEBLE 3500).

items.label: button ingot
items.quote: The pure Mo (99.99 wt%) and the pure V (99.99 wt%) blocks (Trillion Metals Co. Ltd, Beijing China) were used as starting materials. The samples were prepared in the non-consumable tungsten arc furnace which was under titanium-gettered high purity Ar atmosphere. Each button ingot weights about 4 g and was remelted at least 6 times to make sure its homogeneity.

items.atmosphere_or_container: sealed into a quartz tube under the high purity Ar atmosphere at 0.1 MPa
items.quote: Then each ingot was sealed into a quartz tube under the high purity Ar atmosphere at 0.1 MPa and was annealed in a box-type furnace at 600 and 750   C for the isothermal treatment of 70 days. Afterwards, the ingots were rapidly quenched in ice water, in order to preserve the equilibrium relationship at the given heat treatment temperature.
